request.spec: The steward's dashboard counts are now over the sheet and all its descendants.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The steward's dashboard counts are now over the sheet and all its descendants.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The steward's dashboard now counts claims across the sheet and all its descendants. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec. After that run I only rewrapped a comment in the endpoint's YAML file.

**What changed:** In `RespondWithDashboard.java`, the pending, review and overdue counts used to cover only the loaded sheet. They now go through that sheet plus every sheet below it (children, their children, and so on) and add up the totals. It uses the existing `Settings#descendants`, the same lookup the audit view and plans already use.

Two choices the request didn't spell out:
- **Overdue dates:** each sheet's claims are checked as overdue against that sheet's own today, not the parent's. In the first test the child sheet's today is 2026-03-20 while the parent's is 2026-03-10.
- **Who sees the counts:** whether you're a steward is still checked only on the sheet you loaded. A steward there sees counts that include child sheets, even child sheets where they have no role.

I also updated the description comments in `dashboard.GET.yml` and `dashboard.slot.tsx` to match. No `data-testid` values or screen behaviour changed.
